Warden helps you stay informed about safety information in your area.

Explore an interactive map designed to make relevant community safety information easier to access and understand.

HOW WARDEN WORKS

1. Explore. View safety information available for your area on an interactive map.
2. Check your surroundings. Navigate the map to better understand safety information around locations that matter to you.
3. Stay informed. Use Warden as an additional resource when learning about your surroundings.

SAFETY MAP

Warden organizes location-based safety information into a simple map experience, helping you explore information relevant to your area in one place.

WHY PEOPLE USE WARDEN

Safety information can be spread across different sources and difficult to navigate. Warden provides a simple way to explore relevant information and better understand your surroundings.

Information available through Warden is provided for general informational and awareness purposes only. Availability, accuracy, and timeliness may vary depending on the underlying source. Warden should not be used as a substitute for official government resources, emergency services, or professional advice.

If you believe you or someone else is in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services.

Pay-per-book: Your first notebook with unlimited pages is included with your initial purchase, and you can add up to four more books for a one-time fee of $1.99 each. All features included, forever. No subscriptions, ever. That is a promise. 

TypeDraw brings the joy and simplicity of a paper notebook into the digital world, with smart tools to find your notes whenever you need them and endless ways to make it yours. All topped off with stunning cover art options made by real humans and endless ways to personalise your notebook.

No account required. Your notes stay local and private on your device, or sync through your own iCloud account if you choose. Your data stays yours, and you can even lock your book. Export a single page or your whole book as a PDF and send it to your files, your agents or your mother.

- Opens to what matters in the moment: a fresh page, your most recent note, or a note from that restaurant you’re finally visiting again after years. To enter swipe the book cover or jump straight into what you need with a beautiful Home Screen widget. 

- Type, draw and write anywhere, just as you would in a real notebook. Link Notes, add photos, PDFs, timestamps, checklists, titles, bullet points and more to your notes. Turn the pages with a curl or a tap, sketch with your fingers, or use Apple Pencil on iPad and iPhone Duo. It adapts to how you want to use it: whether you prefer typing, drawing or using Apple’s Scribble feature, TypeDraw adjusts to you, not the other way around.

- Enjoy a free canvas where text and drawings belong together. Highlight or underline text, and your strokes automatically convert to responsive “Smart Marks” that adapt when you edit words, change line breaks or adjust the layout. 

- Make it yours! Pick lined, grid, blank or dotted paper and explore 12 handwritten typefaces from Shaped Fonts, choose from all preinstalled iOS system fonts or even upload your own. And if that’s not enough, turn your handwriting into a font you can type with in just minutes. Choose your page colour, ink colour, font size and text colour for all pages or just one specific page, and go wild. Ooh, and wait until you’ve seen our gorgeous Dark Mode.

- Choose from beautiful cover artworks from our own TypeDraw collection or explore premium art from illustrators like Gabor Estefan and make your notebook something truly satisfying to look at every time you open it. Take that, generative AI!

- Add up to four additional notebooks to your setup. Each requires a small one-time in-app purchase so we can keep the app subscription-free. Switch between books by long-pressing the cover, selecting one in Settings or, on iPhone Duo and iPad, swiping in the desk view.

- Keep an overview with a table of contents you can sort by page number, time or location… so the notes nearest to you are always easy to find. All notes are searchable, too, and you can reorder them with a simple drag and drop.

- Have fun and don’t take life too seriously!

Groundwire: the SIP softphone for your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a SIP softphone app from Acrobits, a leader in VoIP and communication software since 2009. It delivers clear voice and video calls for personal and professional use, with an interface built for daily calling and none of the clutter.

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ

Groundwire is a SIP client, not a VoIP service. You need service from a VoIP provider or PBX that supports standard SIP clients.

Business calling features

Groundwire carries the call handling you expect from a desk phone:

- Group calls, for conferencing several people into one conversation.
- Attended transfers, so you can announce a caller before handing the call over.
- Unattended transfers, when the caller just needs the right extension.
- Voicemail with notifications, so a missed call still reaches you.
- Instant messaging, for the things that do not need a call.
- Per-account settings, so one device carries several SIP identities cleanly.

Works with your PBX or VoIP provider

Groundwire is a universal client and true VoIP for PBX users. Teams run it as an Asterisk softphone, a FreePBX extension, or a 3CX endpoint, and it connects just as readily to hosted PBX systems and business phone providers. It also comes preconfigured for major providers, so setup takes minutes. Because it is a standard client, there is no lock-in: bring the account you already have, and Groundwire becomes the mobile extension of your PBX, with encrypted SIP calling on every network.

On a team it is the business softphone dialer sitting on top of the PBX you already pay for. On your own it keeps a work line separate, or carries a desk extension in your pocket.

Key features of the softphone

- Audio on widely used codecs, Opus, G.729 and G.711 among them.
- Video calls at 720p HD, carried by H.264 and VP8.
- Private conversations with military-grade encryption, including TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP.
- Low battery use thanks to efficient push notifications.
- The VoIP dialer hands calls over between WiFi and mobile data without dropping them.
- Custom call settings, UI, and ringtones per account.
- 5G ready and compatible with most mobile operating systems.

A softphone app without the fees

Groundwire is a softphone for calling over WiFi and mobile data, with the business dialer features that usually cost a monthly fee. One payment, no subscription, nothing hidden: buy it once and it stays yours. Encryption sits inside that price rather than on top of it.

Run a call center, manage a fleet of extensions, or keep a dependable sip phone for a home office. The same app covers all of it, without extra tiers.

Download Groundwire and put a dependable SIP dialer on your phone, with Acrobits engineering and responsive support behind it.

iFacialMocap allows you to capture facial expressions in an iOS app and communicate in real time with 3DCG software on your PC. You can also do an FBX export by email.PC-side software allows you to import VRM models.

To export FBX, turn on the REC mode and record. And when you press the mail button, the version selection screen of FBX appears, and when you press the OK button, the FBX file is saved in the File folder and the mailer starts.

Detailed usage is available at the following URL:
https://ifacialmocap.com/

This app can create face animations by communicating with Maya, Unity, 3dsMax and Blender in real time. In addition, animations created in real time can be baked.

This app can load VRM avatars within the iOS app. In addition, this app is linked with VMagicMirror on the PC and VRM related apps such as Luppet and HANA_APP.

To use, first start this app, then start "iFacialMocap to SoftWare app" on your PC and enter your iPhone's IP address.
(Donwload from PC use :https://ifacialmocap.com/download/
)

 Next, create up to 52 morph targets (BlendShape or ShapeKey) according to the naming convention.
Finally, use 3DCG software to load the script / add-on and press the connection button.

Very accurate facial motion capture can be performed very easily.

This app uses ARKit on devices that support ARKit facial tracking, and MediaPipe with the front camera on other supported devices. The camera image and resulting depth data are only used to send motion capture data to the user's PC. That data is not stored in the iPhone. To get depth data from Apple's API, access to the camera is required.

This application is only used for communication with PCs within the same network and does not send information to third parties.

TrueDepth is not required on supported devices. Tracking accuracy depends on the device and capture conditions. Camera access permission is required.

Conduit is a native mobile client for Open WebUI, direct model endpoints, and self-hosted agents. Your chats live on your device first. Nothing routes through a backend the maintainer operates.

Three ways to connect
- Open WebUI — your self-hosted server with chats, folders, notes, channels, workspace, tools, web search, and image generation
- Direct — OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama, OpenRouter, and local endpoints. No Open WebUI account required
- Hermes — your self-hosted agent with live tools, approvals for sensitive steps, and scheduled work

Built for mobile
- Real-time streaming chat with model selection, temporary chats, search, and folders
- File, image, audio, and clipboard uploads for multimodal prompts
- Voice input, voice-call mode, share sheet, quick actions, home screen widgets, and Shortcuts
- Rich rendering for Markdown, code, LaTeX, Mermaid, Chart.js, citations, reasoning, and tool calls
- Notes, saved prompts, channels, terminal, and other features when your server supports them

Built for real deployments
- Sign in with username/password, LDAP, JWT, OAuth/SSO, reverse-proxy flows, and custom HTTP headers
- Credentials stored securely in Keychain
- No ads, no analytics SDKs, and no developer-operated relay server

Important
- Conduit does not host models or provide an AI service. You connect to servers and providers you control.
- Available features depend on what you connect to.
- Conduit is open source and is not officially affiliated with Open WebUI or Hermes.

iBend Pipe — Bend It Right the 1st Time

iBend Pipe is a professional conduit bending calculator designed to help electricians make accurate bends faster and reduce wasted material. Whether you're bending a simple offset or laying out a complex compound bend around an obstruction, iBend Pipe gives you the information you need to bend it right—the first time.



CONDUIT BENDING CALCULATORS

Calculate the following bends using English or Metric measurements:

• Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction
• Rolling Offsets — bend toward or away from an obstruction
• Parallel Offset Adjustments
• 3-Bend Saddles
• 4-Bend Saddles
• Segmented Bends
• Concentric 90° Bends
• 90° Bends
• Back-to-Back 90° Bends
• Kicked 90° Bends
• Compound 90° Bends around round obstructions
• Compound 90° Bends around square obstructions
• Compound 90° Bends around rectangular obstructions



FAST, ONE-SCREEN CALCULATIONS

Enter your measurements and see results update instantly. There's no need to work through multiple screens just to get a measurement. iBend Pipe is designed to keep the calculation and results visible so you can work quickly and efficiently.

Large, easy-to-read measurements make the app practical to use on the job.



ACCURATE, PRACTICAL RESULTS

iBend Pipe goes beyond basic bending multipliers. Centerline bending radius calculations are available for greater accuracy, and bends automatically account for shrink so you don't have to do the math yourself.

Want to know where a number came from? On the basic bend screens, a step-by-step breakdown shows exactly how each result was calculated, with fractions.

Pre-position your bends, plan your layout, and get the information you need before you start bending.

What's faster—bending it twice or bending it right the first time?



BUILT-IN LEVEL

Tap the Level button on any calculation to check your bend angle as you bend. Your calculation's bend angles are loaded in as targets, and the level shows you when you've hit the angle, so you don't have to switch between tools.



BENDER PROFILES

iBend Pipe includes more than 330 bender and conduit combinations from manufacturers including Greenlee, Klein, IDEAL, Milwaukee, Gardner Bender, Current Tools and iTOOLco. Find your bender quickly by filtering by size, type, material and manufacturer. You can also customize or modify profiles to match the benders and conduit you use in the field.



FRACTIONS, NOT JUST DECIMALS

Enter measurements as fractions instead of converting everything to decimals. The keypad replaces the old value as soon as you start typing, so entering measurements is quick. Get your results in practical measurements you can use on the job.



iPHONE AND iPAD

iBend Pipe works on iPhone and iPad. On larger screens, many calculations show the diagram and inputs side by side.



BUILT FOR ELECTRICIANS

iBend Pipe is for the electrician who takes pride in their work.

If you're the person other electricians come to when they have a difficult bend, this app is for you. If you want less wasted conduit in the bone pile, this app is for you. If you can write your name in conduit, this app is definitely for you.

From a first-year apprentice to a seasoned journeyman, iBend Pipe is designed to save time, reduce wasted material, and make difficult conduit bends easier to plan.

Bend it right. The first time.

Thanks for all the great reviews! If you have questions or suggestions, contact me at:

support@ibendpipe.com

Make voice and video calls, send messages, and stay connected with Acrobits Softphone App, a powerful and feature-rich SIP softphone designed for all your calling needs.

BEFORE YOU BUY

Acrobits Softphone is a SIP client app. It does not come with phone service: you sign in with the SIP account your VoIP provider, PBX or employer gives you. Note: this app does not support call transfer or conference calling.

Acrobits Softphone works out of the box with many of the most popular VoIP providers and Bluetooth devices on the market. If you already have SIP service, from work or from any VoIP company, you are ready to go.

It brings all the popular features you expect from a SIP app, including support for 5G, voice and video calling, push notifications, call handover between WiFi and data, multi-device compatibility, lifetime access to support and updates, and more.

Keep a work line separate from your personal number. Carry a home-office extension in your pocket, or call over WiFi while traveling. Calls run over WiFi and mobile data, so your sip phone works wherever you have a connection, at home or abroad.

Bring the account you already have. Acrobits Softphone is a standards-based SIP client, so it registers with Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, hosted PBX platforms and everyday business VoIP services alike. Sign in with your SIP account and you have a business softphone dialer that carries your work line anywhere. Encrypted SIP calling keeps every conversation private.

Calls stay clear with support for popular audio standards, including Opus, G.722, G.729, G.711, iLBC, and GSM. Need video? It goes up to 720p HD with both H.264 and VP8. Pair it with the Bluetooth headsets and car kits you already use. Push notifications do the waiting, so the app stays reachable in the background. And voice is not the whole story: send messages from the same app when a call is too much.

You can set it up your way, with custom call settings, ringtones, and UI options.

And because it follows open standards, you are never locked in. Switch providers whenever you like and keep the same app, the same contacts, and the same settings.

Acrobits Softphone makes it easy to communicate with friends and family on any device. And it runs on virtually all iPhones and iPads.

Don't worry about hidden fees or subscriptions. You pay once, and lifetime support and updates are included. Secure VoIP is part of the deal rather than an upgrade. Try it today, and see why softphone users have trusted Acrobits since 2009.

Turn your phone over. Leave the screen behind. Focus with Tom.

Bear Focus Timer is a simple Pomodoro timer for work, study, reading, writing, and everyday tasks. Choose a session, place your iPhone face down, and let Tom the bear keep you company while the timer runs. When focus time ends, take a break and receive an illustrated praise card.

FLIP TO FOCUS
• Choose your focus time and place your iPhone face down to begin
• Keep the screen out of sight while you work or study
• Build a small physical ritual around starting a focused session

CUSTOM POMODORO CYCLES
• Alternate focus sessions with breaks
• Adjust focus and break durations
• Choose a rhythm that fits the task in front of you

FOREST-STYLE WHITE NOISE
Add an optional nature-inspired background sound to your session. The calm audio and hand-drawn black-and-white design create a simple setting for time spent on one task.

TOM AND PRAISE CARDS
Tom is friendly, but he notices when it is time to concentrate. Complete a session to receive an illustrated praise card, then save a favorite card to Photos. Praise cards are available in English, Korean, and Japanese.

APPLE WATCH SUPPORT
Use the Apple Watch version when you want focus and break timing on your wrist. Available alerts and session behavior can vary according to your device and operating system settings.

USE IT FOR
• Study sessions and exam preparation
• Reading, writing, and creative work
• Work sprints and personal projects
• Chores or any task that benefits from a defined focus period and break

Bear Focus Timer keeps the experience straightforward: set your time, turn the phone over, focus, and take a break with Tom.

Support: BearFocusTimer@gmail.com

First developed in 2008, 12 Steps Companion was the world’s first recovery app. It is a reader, sobriety tracker, and recovery toolkit.

The reader covers the first 164 pages of Alcoholics Anonymous, plus more than 60 personal stories, the original forewords, and the appendices from the First and Second Editions. Dark mode, highlighting, adjustable type, a concordance search, and a built-in dictionary are included.

Also available: 12 Steps Speakers, for talks recorded by members around the world.

KEY FEATURES

UNIVERSAL • Built for iPhone and iPad • Cloud-themed design and a quiet, discrete home-screen icon

SOBRIETY CALCULATOR & WIDGETS • Sobriety length on the launch screen • Home-screen widgets with years, months, days, and hours

THE READER • Dark mode • Highlight and unhighlight text • Adjustable font size • Full-screen reading in portrait or landscape • First 164 pages, plus 60+ stories from the 1st and 2nd editions • Original forewords and appendices • Page numbers and quick page jump • Tap any word to define it • Collapsible index • Return to a bookmark from any note

SEARCH • Full concordance • Results highlighted in place

PRAYERS & PROMISES • Morning and night prayers • Prayers from the Twelve Steps • Prayer of St. Francis • Promises collected from the text

NOTES • Highlight a passage and attach a note • Share via Messages, Mail, and other apps • App attribution is added when you share

CONTACTS • U.S. central offices, areas, districts, and answering services • Tap to call, email, or open a website • Maps and directions • Add your own contacts

SUPPORT Questions or feedback: www.deanhuff.com

Only stories from the 1st and 2nd editions are included • This app is available to U.S. customers only

Most apps you open. This one you display.

Bauhaus Clock isn't a widget for checking time. It's a clock for keeping time. Designed for your desk, home office, studio or nightstand: the spaces where your device rests, not where you scroll.

Swiss watch mechanics. 28,800 beats per hour. Hand-tuned details you won't consciously notice but will absolutely feel.

"This is absolutely stunning."
Chris Messina, Inventor of #hashtag

"I love the subtle depth like the hour indices."
John Gruber, Creator of Markdown

"One of very few delightful apps to hit my iPhone in the last few years."
Josh Ginter, The Newsprint


WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• Optimized for iPhone Duo
Beautifully crafted for every pose, open or closed.

• 3 Authentic Watch Movements
Smooth 4Hz mechanical sweep at 28,800 beats per hour. Classic quartz tick. Digital glide motion. Real Swiss caliber accuracy. Not an animation. Physics. Turn on Clock Ticking to hear Quartz and Mechanical tick as they run.

• Hand-built dial craft
Hand-tuned palettes, custom numerals, depth from real shadowing, built by someone who over-invested so you don't have to pretend it's "good enough." The result looks like a high-end mechanical watch.

• 18 Day Dials
Each color is deliberately crafted to match your space, now with Agave and Burgundy. Pick the one that feels like yours.

• 14 Lume Colors for Night
Night mode that reads like real watch lume, with a glow carefully tuned to match authentic luminescence.

• Dual Time Zones
Your time zone plus any city in the world. Perfect for remote work, travel, or keeping track of family abroad. One glance, two clocks. Show them in Full Screen on iPad and iPhone Duo, or only when you turn your device sideways.

• Dial Shuffle
Enable once. Every time you return to the app, it surprises you with a new dial and lume combination.

• Home Screen Widgets
Local Time, Dual Time and World Clock, with Local Time and World Clock now also in a large size. Customize each widget on its own, or keep them all in sync with the app.

• Day & Night Scheduling
Three ways to control when your clock dial switches in Auto Mode: Follow System, switch at actual Sunset to Sunrise, or set your own Time Schedule.

• StandBy Mode
Built for iOS StandBy, night mode activates automatically to match the dark, minimal aesthetic. Pick Silver Hands or any lume color for the widget.


WHAT PEOPLE SAY AND FEEL

"Makes me so happy whenever the clock pops up."
Hyatt N., Director

"It brings me so much joy."
Anthony Menecola

"Incredible attention to detail."
Fons Mans, Founder of Offgrid.inc

Bauhaus Clock started as a screensaver for Mac. Built by a designer who loves watches and couldn't find one he actually wanted to look at. Every detail is intentional. The weight of the hands, the numerals, the texture of the dial, the way light hits the indices. Featured by MKBHD, MacRumors and Uncrate.

Now on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.


WHAT YOU DON'T GET

No ads.
No tracking.
No subscriptions.
No data collection.
No account required.

Buy once. Own forever. Updates included.


WHAT YOU GET, FEATURES

- 18 dial colors: White, Turquoise, Glacier, Ocean, Tennis, Signal Blue, Salmon, Yellow, Beige, Pistachio, Lavender, Rose, Sky Blue, Cream, Slate, Noir, Agave, Burgundy
- 14 lume colors for night mode: Red, Amber, Lavender, Rose, Seafoam, Sky, Lagoon, Peach, Tritium Green, Aqua, Yellow, Lime, Ice Blue, White
- 3 movements: Quartz, Mechanical, Digital
- Clock Ticking for Quartz and Mechanical
- Dual Time with world city selector, Full Screen and Only in Landscape
- Auto Mode: Follow System, Sunset to Sunrise or Time Schedule
- Dial Shuffle
- Widgets: Local Time, Dual Time, World Clock and StandBy
- A matching app icon for every dial
- Auto-launch when charging via Shortcuts

Bauhaus Clock isn't a widget for checking time. It's a clock for keeping time. Designed for your desk, home office, studio or nightstand: the spaces where your device rests, not where you scroll.

Swiss watch mechanics. 28,800 beats per hour. Hand-tuned details you won't consciously notice but will absolutely feel.

"This is absolutely stunning."
Chris Messina, Inventor of #hashtag

"I love the subtle depth like the hour indices."
John Gruber, Creator of Markdown

"One of very few delightful apps to hit my iPhone in the last few years."
Josh Ginter, The Newsprint


WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• Optimized for iPhone Duo
Beautifully crafted for every pose, open or closed.

• 3 Authentic Watch Movements
Smooth 4Hz mechanical sweep at 28,800 beats per hour. Classic quartz tick. Digital glide motion. Real Swiss caliber accuracy. Not an animation. Physics. Turn on Clock Ticking to hear Quartz and Mechanical tick as they run.

• Hand-built dial craft
Hand-tuned palettes, custom numerals, depth from real shadowing, built by someone who over-invested so you don't have to pretend it's "good enough." The result looks like a high-end mechanical watch.

Each color is deliberately crafted to match your space, now with Agave and Burgundy. Pick the one that feels like yours.

• Dual Time Zones
Your time zone plus any city in the world. Perfect for remote work, travel, or keeping track of family abroad. One glance, two clocks. Show them in Full Screen on iPad and iPhone Duo, or only when you turn your device sideways.

Enable once. Every time you return to the app, it surprises you with a new dial and lume combination.

Local Time, Dual Time and World Clock, with Local Time and World Clock now also in a large size. Customize each widget on its own, or keep them all in sync with the app.

Three ways to control when your clock dial switches in Auto Mode: Follow System, switch at actual Sunset to Sunrise, or set your own Time Schedule.

leads.description:
Connect to Philips Hue Entertainment, LIFX, and Nanoleaf Light Panels and take command of your music & entertainment lighting needs. Customize one of over 100+ professionally-designed lighting effects using the app's 3 unique lighting controllers. Light DJ Pro has been used in many creative applications, including special effects for home DJs, house parties, stage & video productions, holiday decorations, mood lighting for bars & restaurants, haunted houses, or just to create the ultimate music listening experience in your living room. Light DJ Pro is the #1 app for configurable entertainment effects for smart lighting.

*** THIS IS THE FULLY-UNLOCKED VERSION. You'll get all the benefits of a subscriber and only have to pay once. To sign up for a Light DJ subscription search for LIGHT DJ ENTERTAINMENT EFFECTS in the App Store! ***

MUSIC VISUALIZER: Create the ultimate music listening experience. The app listens to your music and changes the effects based on the mood of the song. Lights get active during intense parts of a song and flowy with softer melodies and magically change colors at just the right moment. Special controls for Nanoleaf allow you to control rotation and fill angle to match your Nanoleaf panel orientation.

STROBE MAKER: Strobe your lights with 5 different types of effects with the Matrix Strobe Maker. Tap and swipe using multitouch and 3D Touch (on supported models).

BEAT-SYNCED EFFECTS: Use the Super SceneMaker controller for looping effects that sync to the beat of your music. Each of the 100+ effects can be customized with your favorite colors. Just turn on your lights and let the SceneMaker run all night long. Control the speed of your lights with precision manual tempo controls or auto beat detection using your device's built-in microphone. Mix local audio tracks into your playlists and sheets or select one from Apple Music.

HUE ENTERTAINMENT: Using a Hue Entertainment area you'll enjoy higher quality effects; all of Light DJ's effects respond faster and with better sync. Send waves of color across your room with the updated Groove Wave effect, or strobe faster with the Matrix controller.

EFFECT MAKER: Create your own looping special effects with our powerful Effects Maker. Share your custom-made effects and effect sheets with your friends using AirDrop.

IPAD VERSION: The iPad app offers a DJ Controller-inspired design for ultimate live-performance lighting control. Configurable sheets allow you to setup your effects and colors in advance, and big push-buttons make rapid changes easy.

MULTI-BRIDGE SUPPORT: Combine lights from two or more bridges using the legacy effects or control multiple simultaneous entertainment areas.

ABLETON LINK & MIDI SUPPORT: Seamlessly sync tempo with other apps & devices using Ableton Link or MIDI Clock Sync. Control effects by sending Program Change codes over MIDI.

--- Light DJ vs Light DJ Pro ---
Want the full experience without having to worry about renewing your subscription? This version will include all benefits of the subscription service without the recurring payments. You'll get the same benefits as a Light DJ Pro Subscription user without having to keep paying:
-Full use of all of the app's controllers and effects
-Universal access & cloud sync
-Continual updates to support new hardware and features
-Direct email technical support (I respond to every email!)
-For more details see lightdjapp.com/blog

Visit lightdjapp.com for support or check out video previews at instagram.com/LightDJ

This app requires hardware from one of these vendors:
- Philips Hue: meethue.com - All lights
- LIFX: lifx.com - All lights
- Nanoleaf: nanoleaf.me - All WiFi-based lights & panels

----

Hi, I'm Kevin, creator of Light DJ Pro. I want to make sure that everyone gets a great light show, so if you're having issues getting the app to connect send me an email at kevin@nrthrnlights.com. I'm dedicated to making a quality app to show off your lights!

Apple "New apps and games we love" (on the Mac), March 2017

Apple "Staff Favourite" in the UK (on iOS), Jul/Aug 2010

Account Tracker is a powerful personal finance app that helps you track spending and monitor balances across multiple accounts. Its clean, intuitive user interface, and features such as alerts, bill reminders, budgets, reports and full multi-currency support, make it easy to take control of your finances.

This Pro version is a subscription-free version of Account Tracker, with exactly the same content plus basic support for Apple Watch. Try Account Tracker before you buy, it is free to download and supports a 1 month FREE TRIAL. Simply cancel before being charged.

Also check out Account Tracker for Mac, now available on the Mac App Store. It requires Account Tracker version 6 or above (to sync over iCloud or Dropbox), and macOS Sierra (10.12) or above.

ACCOUNTS
- Track multiple accounts: checking, current, savings, credit cards, loans/mortgages ... etc
- Separate your accounts into groups, e.g. personal vs business accounts
- Enter your recurring transactions using calendar-based repeat intervals, e.g. every 2 weeks, the last Friday of every month ... etc
- Quickly and simply enter one-off transactions as they happen
- Reconcile your account data with your statements
- While it is useful to see where your money goes, you can also look FORWARDS, showing all of your future commitments
- Alerts if an account is likely to go overdrawn or hit its overdraft limit

BILLS
- Enable reminders for non-automatic transactions, e.g. bills that you have to pay manually
- View all transactions with reminders set
- Alerts to tell you when these transactions are due

BUDGETS
- Add budgets per category for spending, income and transfers across individual or multiple accounts
- View these as daily, weekly, fortnightly/biweekly, monthly, yearly or custom dates (e.g. tax years)
- Monitor your transactions against the goals you set

REPORTS
- Detailed reports to really understand your financial position
- Account balance over time, cash flow, spending by category or payee detail, income by category or payer and transfers by category
- View these as daily, weekly, fortnightly/biweekly, monthly, yearly or custom dates (e.g. tax years)
- Export or print reports as PDF files

DATA, BACKUPS AND SYNCING
- Import historical transactions or bank statements from a CSV file
- Export account statements, budgets and reports in CSV format for offline processing, e.g. in a spreadsheet
- Local backup and restore on your device, plus transfer of backups by AirDrop, email, Dropbox or iCloud
- Support for database syncing across multiple devices (using either Dropbox or iCloud)
- PIN code protection, plus Face/Touch ID and 1Password integration

PLUS
- Full multi-currency support, per account and per transaction
- The default currency is the one local to your device, but this can be overridden
- Supports sub-categories and splitting a transaction across multiple categories/subcategories
- Universal, retina enabled app that works on the iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch - buy once, use it on ALL of your devices
- Also supports the Apple Watch, to display account balances and a snapshot of your main budgets
- In-app user guide

SUPPORT
Please use the link to my support page from the AppStore page or from the app itself (or simply go to http://grahamhaley.co.uk/accounts/).

Alternatively, contact me directly via my support pages and you will get a quick response.
